name: Akasaka Miyuki
source:
She is [url=/c3813]Akasaka[/url]'s daughter, and was 5 years old in 1983. She is proud of her father, who is busy with his official duties, but at the same time, she sometimes feels lonely. However, she is a kind girl who tries not to let him worry about her.

[From [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Miyuki_Akasaka]Miyuki Akasaka[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]
